label: Bible Study
prompt: He that is _____ to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
verse: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
note: Self-control beats conquest — ruling your own spirit outranks taking a city.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For thou wilt light my _____: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.
verse: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.
note: God lights my candle — and even a small flame changes a dark room.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of _____,
verse: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
note: A nod to Daniel among Hebrews' heroes of faith: those who 'stopped the mouths of lions.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The _____ shall live by faith.
verse: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.
note: Paul quotes Habakkuk 2:4 here — a line so central it gets quoted again in Galatians and Hebrews.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: I therefore so run, not as _____; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air:
verse: I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air:
note: Paul the athlete doesn't run 'uncertainly' or shadowbox — 'not as one that beateth the air.'
